label: Asura Blade
overflowParts: the two long sabers and the long hair
description: a young demon-king warrior (an asura): very long wild silver-white hair flowing back like flames, pale ash-grey skin, sharp glowing red eyes and a fierce arrogant grin, a bare muscular torso with dark crimson demon tattoo lines on the chest, shoulders and arms, a thick knotted dark crimson rope tied around the waist, a long layered deep crimson battle skirt over black trousers, black wrapped shins and bare feet, holding exactly TWO long demonic black sabers (Chinese dao), one in each hand, exactly as in the reference: in the raised back hand a curved scimitar-like blade with a few notches on the spine and a tip that curls into a hook; in the front hand a broad saber with a jagged serrated spine and a hooked tip; both black steel with glowing blood-red vein lines like cracks of lava, dark crimson edges, horned demon-skull cross-guards, black hilts with bone-white spikes and crimson-wrapped grips

portrait.prompt: Now something different: NOT a sprite sheet. Draw ONE single square character-select portrait (one image, no grid, no frames) of the same character ({description}), in the same pixel-art style but more detailed: chest-up close-up, the face large with a fierce arrogant grin and glowing red eyes, wild silver-white hair blowing, the two black demonic sabers with glowing red veins crossed in front of the bare tattooed chest, the head turned three-quarters toward the right, dramatic rim lighting. Solid dark crimson and black smoke background with a subtle pixel texture, no other characters, no text, no logo, no watermark, no frame.

actions.label: Idle
actions.note: A wild, low, aggressive twin-saber fighting stance. The feet stay in the same place in every frame; only the body bobs and breathes.
poses: rest pose in the guard stance
body dips about 2 pixels, shoulders relax
returning to the rest pose, very close to frame 1 so the loop is seamless

actions.label: Walk Forward
actions.note: A guarded step toward the RIGHT. The character stays centred in its cell (walking in place).
poses: contact: front (right) foot stepping forward, guard up
down: weight shifts, knees bend, body dips slightly
passing: the free leg moves past the planted leg
passing, opposite leg, leading smoothly into frame 1

actions.label: Walk Backward
actions.note: A retreating step: still FACING RIGHT toward the enemy, guard up, stepping backward (to the left). The character stays centred in its cell.
poses: contact: back (left) foot placed behind, guard up
down: weight shifts, knees bend, body dips slightly
passing: the free leg moves past the planted leg
passing, opposite leg, leading smoothly into frame 1

actions.label: Crouch
actions.note: Six clearly DIFFERENT poses going from standing down to kneeling; the feet stay on the same ground line.
poses: standing guard stance exactly as in the reference, full height
half squat, knees bent, head clearly lower than in frame 1
dropping to one knee, the back knee almost touching the ground
kneeling on one knee, guard up, body only about 60 percent as tall as in frame 1

actions.label: Jump
actions.note: The ground line is at the same height in every frame. Frames 1 and 6 have the feet on the ground line; in frames 3, 4 and 5 the whole character is drawn clearly above the ground line. Keep the character horizontally centred in its cell.
poses: anticipation: deep crouch, feet on the ground line
launch: legs extending, feet leaving the ground
rising: whole body above the ground line, knees tucked
landing: feet back on the ground line, knees bent absorbing the impact

actions.label: Block High
actions.note: Feet stay planted. The block pose is held from frame 3 onward.
poses: guard stance, starting to raise the guard
both sabers crossed in an X in front of the face
block held: both sabers crossed in an X in front of the face and chest, body braced

actions.label: Block Low
actions.note: Feet stay on the ground line. Goes from standing to a LOW crouching block held from frame 3 onward.
poses: crouching low, the guard lowering in front of the knees
block held: deep low crouch kneeling on one knee, guarding the shins, body only about 60 percent as tall as in frame 1

actions.label: Hit High
actions.note: Struck in the face from the RIGHT, recoiling backward to the LEFT; feet stay near the ground line.
poses: impact: head snaps back, eyes shut
maximum recoil: torso bent far back, one foot sliding
back in the guard stance with a pained face

actions.label: Twin Fang
actions.note: A fast double slash: both sabers cut forward toward the RIGHT at head height. The strike frames are 3 and 4.
poses: strike: both sabers slashing forward to the RIGHT at head height
full extension: both sabers slashing forward to the RIGHT at head height, a short white impact streak touching it

actions.label: Ground Rend
actions.note: A low spinning sweep: the fighter drops low and both sabers cut along the ground toward the RIGHT at ankle height. The strike frames are 3 and 4.
poses: wind-up, body turning, the attack chambered
strike: both sabers sweeping low to the RIGHT just above the ground, a motion arc touching it
full extension: both sabers sweeping low to the RIGHT just above the ground

actions.label: Asura Awakening
actions.note: Powering up in place; feet stay planted. A dark grey smoky aura with a few white sparks curls around the body and both sabers (dark grey and white only, no colours). The aura always touches the body (no separate floating sparks).

actions.label: Asura Twin Crescent
actions.note: No melee attack boxes: frames 2 and 4 are the two big slashes, and the engine launches a purple blade-qi crescent on each (src/game/bladeQi.ts LAUNCH_FRAMES). IMPORTANT: NINE frames in a 3x3 grid (3 columns and 3 ROWS). Plain white slash arcs only (no colours), each arc touching its saber. Effects always touch the fighter or weapon.
poses: first hit: a huge wide horizontal slash with the front saber, a big white crescent arc touching the blade toward the RIGHT
second hit: a huge wide rising slash with the back saber, a big white crescent arc touching the blade toward the RIGHT
third hit, the finisher: both sabers crossing in a giant X slash toward the RIGHT, a large burst

actions.label: Knockdown
actions.note: Hit from the RIGHT, falling backward to the LEFT, ending lying on the back with the head to the left and the feet to the right. The lying body must fit inside its cell.
poses: hitting the ground on the back, small dust puff touching the body
lying flat, head to the left, feet to the right
